notes.subject: חנה
notes.rationale: 'Encamp' evokes a military camp pitched around the defenseless — the same verb used of Israel's camps in the wilderness; the picture of a besieging protection is the verse's core image.

notes.subject: ויחלצם
notes.rationale: Root חלץ 'to pull off/strip': 'he delivers them' (most versions) vs YLT's literal 'he armeth them' — the same root underlies weaponry (arms pulled off a foe), so 'rescue' and 'arm' share one Hebrew word.

translation: Malaika wa Yahwe o hema leka-lekane ga bao ba mo boifago, gomme o ba lokolla.
